observations: Blue and black high-pressure water cleaning machine.

The unit is resting on a light-colored wooden surface.

claims.claim: pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the pump may not deliver pressure.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in and the pressure gauge reading a high value.

risks.risk: The internal water tank may be empty or contaminated.
risks.proof: A photo of the empty tank and the water level inside.

risks.risk: The internal pump may be seized or leaking.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through a pressure test cycle.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and the pressure gauge reading.
Photo of the empty water tank.
Photo of the manufacturer's specification plate.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
